svg.title: AgentCore Public Stack platform architecture
svg.desc: Clients reach one CloudFront distribution that serves the Angular SPA from S3 and proxies /api to an ALB in front of the App API on ECS Fargate. The App API is the only caller of the AgentCore Runtime hosting the Inference API and Strands agent, which uses Amazon Bedrock, tools, AgentCore services and MCP servers. DynamoDB, S3, Cognito and Bedrock Knowledge Bases hold application state. Artifacts and MCP Apps are served from two further CloudFront distributions.
